scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
scripts.icons: node assets/emblem.mjs && node assets/web-icons.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --ios --android --iconBackgroundColor "#04070b" --iconBackgroundColorDark "#04070b" --splashBackgroundColor "#04070b" --splashBackgroundColorDark "#04070b"
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
